bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'PROFILE_PREDEPLOY_AUDIT\n'
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 60
docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format 'IMAGE={{.Image}}'
docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:link-mp4-document-4d24 --format 'EXPECTED_IMAGE={{.Id}}'
docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d ' ' -f1 | sed 's/^/BUNDLE_SHA256=/'
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT 'PROFILE_PUBLISHED='||count(*) FROM profile_publications WHERE status='published' AND message_id>0;"
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT 'PROFILE_ELIGIBLE='||count(*) FROM profile_publications pub JOIN profiles p ON p.owner_user_id=pub.owner_user_id AND p.status='published' JOIN posting_topics t ON t.chat_id=pub.chat_id AND t.message_thread_id=pub.thread_id AND t.purpose='profile' AND t.enabled=TRUE AND t.verified_by IS NOT NULL AND t.verified_at IS NOT NULL WHERE pub.status='published' AND pub.synced_revision>0 AND pub.message_id>0 AND pub.public_snapshot IS NOT NULL;"
printf 'POSTS_UNMODIFIED=YES\n'
